items.label: ✅ GENUINE LEATHER
items.value: Crafted from premium-quality leather, our handmade bags boast timeless designs and expert craftsmanship. Each bag is unique, with natural variations in texture and color that enhance its character.

items.label: ✅ SLEEK & FUNCTIONAL
items.value: THIS CROSSBODY BAG IS MEDIUM SIZED. It features high-end fittings like YKK zippers and metal buttons and fittings. Designed for convenience, it offers a roomy main compartment and a small exterior pocket for essentials. Please review the dimensions to ensure it suits your needs

items.label: ✅ SIZE & STORAGE
items.value: With an over-flap closure, this bag measures 9 x 10.5 x 3.5 inches and includes a 26-inch adjustable shoulder strap. Inside, you'll find a concealed zip pocket and a dedicated mobile holder. Kindly verify the dimensions before purchase.

items.label: ✅ A MEANINGFUL GIFT
items.value: Looking for a thoughtful gift? This crossbody bag is a stylish and practical option for everyday use. While it's great for travel, we recommend considering the recipient’s style and preferences to ensure the perfect match.

items.label: ✅ ELEVATE YOUR TRAVEL STYLE
items.value: Our bags combine heritage craftsmanship with a refined aesthetic. Available in both dark and light shades, they complement various styles. Choose a color that best reflects your personal taste and needs.

items.label: Product Care Instructions
items.value: Avoid water, use a leather cleaner or conditioner, and store in a cool, dry place.
